title: Failed to copy?
body:
Hi I finally have rclone v1.28 working pretty well - WAY better than the other Google Drive sync tools I've tried, including the paid ones and Google's client. Thanks so much for a great program!

I am using Server 2012 (Windows 64 bit). Here's the command I am using

.\rclone.exe --log-file=rclone2.txt --checkers 2 --transfers 2 --size-only --exclude DBBackup sync F:\Drive\RoboBackup\Monday Google_Drive:RoboBackup\Monday

Here's an error:

2016/04/19 08:14:16 AVImarkSQL/signatur/23544/393554.png: Received error: googleapi: Error 403: Rate Limit Exceeded, rateLimitExceeded - low level retry 1/10
2016/04/19 08:14:24 AVImarkSQL/Attachments/9057/Po/CCF10202015records.pdf: Failed to copy: Post https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v2/files?alt=json&uploadType=resumable: http: ContentLength=206 with Body length 0
2016/04/19 08:14:36 AVImarkSQL/Attachments/23537/Thumbs.db: Received error: googleapi: Error 403: Rate Limit Exceeded, rateLimitExceeded - low level retry 1/10
2016/04/19 08:15:03 AVImarkSQL/signatur/9707/394038.png: Received error: googleapi: Error 403: Rate Limit Exceeded, rateLimitExceeded - low level retry 1/10
2016/04/19 08:15:05 AVImarkSQL/signatur/9707/394038.png: Received error: googleapi: Error 403: Rate Limit Exceeded, rateLimitExceeded - low level retry 2/10

Transferred:    391478457 Bytes (  62.85 kByte/s)
Errors:                13
Checks:             41505
Transferred:          687
Elapsed time:  1h41m22.7s
Transferring:
-                        AVImarkSQL/logdata.mps: 74% done. avg:   74.4, cur:   73.4 kByte/s. ETA: 21m41s
-           AVImarkSQL/signatur/9707/394038.png: 100% done. avg:    3.9, cur:    6.0 kByte/s. ETA: 0s

I read the docs and previous issues about these errors. It looks like the file that caused the problem was eventually transferred (last line of the log). I already specified checkers and transfers in the command. Are there any other ways to mitigate these errors?

thank you!!!!!!!!
